pat: Heads-up - support found a case where a stream resume to a different shard + toolcall truncation led to two billed confirmations; short repro attached.

sam: can you drop the req id & counts?

pat: req_20260415_3 - provisional=82 on shard-A, resume->shard-C confirmed=240, toolcall_truncated=true

maria: Likely provisional wasn't released; resume created new confirmed charge. We need stronger provenance: add provisional_id and resume_session_id to ledger rows.

rina: Design question: do we propagate provisional_id via router header or rely on analytics to dedupe? Prefer header so resumed host can claim/clear idempotently.

sam: Header won't be hard: x-provisional-id + x-resume-session. But must be careful about TTL and id reuse. Runtime must assert claim-before-confirm semantics.

pat: Console/UX ask: show both provisional and confirmed tokens in the request timeline and mark if they originated on different shards. Support frequently asks this.

maria: Telemetry: also emit toolcall_truncated=true; we can then run SQL joins to estimate scope. For quick mitigation, analytics can flag probable duplicates within a 90s window.

rina: Edge case: if truncation reduces final token count below provisional, we must avoid negative adjustments. Reconcile rules should only reduce confirmed if it's clear duplication, else manual review.

sam: I'll add headers + runtime check to ensure a resumed host, if it sees provisional_id, will clear it when confirming. I'll open a tiny RFC for the router header semantics.

ops-bot: Incident INF-3644 created: "resume-handoff provisional id propagation" (owner eng-platform)

pat: Thanks - post trace ids and any sample query results here and we'll coordinate with finance/support for refunds if needed.
